title: CreateConsentGroupRequest
description: Request body for creating a consent group.

name.description: Unique name for the consent group (max 255 characters)

signupMode.description: Controls how contacts are added to the group. `manual` — contacts are added explicitly via the API. `automatic` — contacts are added automatically at signup.

listIds.description: Optional list of contact list IDs. Contacts from these lists will be copied once into this consent group at creation time.
